title: SODAPOP: Open-Ended Discovery of Social Biases in Social Commonsense Reasoning Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and quantifying social biases related to demographic groups (specifically race and gender) using an automated pipeline for generating distractors. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical systems, although it mentions 'social and moral norms' in a citation context and includes standard ethical consideration sections.
